purpose: Necessary normalized-intensity compatibility bound; no synthesis or mask optimization.
l1_bound: For any realizable intensity probabilities p, ||q_i-p_i||_1+||q_j-p_j||_1 >= positive target-moment violation.

provenance.train_sampler: half homogeneous, half independent; original mixed sampler
provenance.moment_arithmetic: float64; targets fetched and peak-normalized as normal float32 evaluator inputs
provenance.moment_origin: array index zero, unnormalized FFT of q=A^2/sum(A^2); pair-difference magnitude is independent of common origin
